source_discrepancies.note: The simultaneous values 2.0 ATA and 101 kPa do not agree if both are absolute at standard pressure. The article does not specify a reference for kPa. Neither value is used to infer chamber exposure pressure.

The Results paragraph describes two abnormal subtests and two distinct categories. Figure 3 marks two simple reaction time subtests and one procedural reaction time subtest below average. Extracted category rows use the figure.
Results gives 11 days, Discussion gives 10 days, and the two dated tests are 11 calendar days apart. Preserve both statements.

observations.outcome_window: Symptoms at altitude during the index training exposure and recurrence six days later. Later clinical and cognitive follow-up described separately.
observations.note: The authors describe DCI and discuss both decompression sickness and gas embolism. A single selected episode without an exposed-roster denominator.
